# commit

Generate a [Conventional Commits v1.0.0](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) message for the currently staged changes via a local LLM.

How to use it, with examples: [AI assistance](/cookbook/ai).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider`, `--backend`, `-b` | TEXT |  | LLM provider: "managed" (local llama.cpp run by fobis, the default), "ollama" or "openai" (--backend is the former name). |
| `--url`, `-u` | TEXT |  | Base URL of the LLM server. |
| `--api-key-env` | TEXT |  | Environment variable holding the API key, sent as a Bearer token (hosted endpoints). |
| `--model`, `-m` | TEXT |  | Model identifier to use. |
| `--max-diff` | INTEGER |  | Maximum staged-diff characters sent to the model. |
| `--refine-passes` | INTEGER |  | Critique-and-rewrite iterations after the initial draft (0 = single pass). Recommended: 1-3 for small/fast models. |
| `--apply` |  |  | Run `git commit` with the generated message after review. |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | Path to a custom FoBiS user config file. |
| `--show-config` |  |  | Show effective LLM configuration and exit. |
| `--init-config` |  |  | Create a commented default config file and exit. |
| `--show-facts` |  |  | Print the facts of the staged change (scope candidates, Fortran line kinds, type hints) and exit; no model is run. |
| `--no-facts` |  |  | Do not compute the facts of the change (free scope). |
| `--json` |  |  | With --show-facts: the facts as JSON. |

<!-- cli:end -->
